reason: We do the free zoo on Saturdays and that works fine. $15 a kid on a weekend, plus coffee and snacks, adds up fast for something that sounds a bit Instagram for Salisbury.
objection: I only have Saturdays, so I'd pay $15 or more per kid for the one day I'd rather be outside at the zoo for free. Membership makes no sense for a once-a-week visit.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to $8-10 a kid, or a free first visit that is actually good and doesn't feel crowded on a Saturday.
